subject: Mathematics
source_key_points: Learners can be asked to rotate themselves around and stop as the teacher announces “statue”.
The learners can notice how much they have turned with respect to their original position.
Can you recognise the child in the picture who has made a full turn?
Give examples of real-life situations where you observe turns.
Ashutosh and Sahana are making circles, each having one foot fixed and rotating at one spot on the ground.
Ashutosh made a complete circle by making a full turn.
Sahana is making a half-moon shape with a half turn.
